latest_release.name: v3.5.1
latest_release.body:
It was too hot, we need a bugfix release this time.

### Bugs

 - Actually put in the new promised Devicons #2057
 - SpaceMono: Remove fi/fl ligs #2062
 - Flatten forgotten font subdirs

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ryanoasis/nerd-fonts/compare/v3.5.0...v3.5.1

Find the SHA checksums of the release artifacts [here](https://github.com/ryanoasis/nerd-fonts/releases/download/v3.5.1/SHA-256.txt).
The .zip and .tar.xz archives have the same contents, just the xz is so much smaller.
